terminalTitleFromRename.description: Stop [`/rename`](/docs/en/sessions#name-your-sessions) and `--name` from changing the terminal tab title

theme.description: Pick the interface [color theme](/docs/en/terminal-config#match-the-color-theme), built-in or custom

timeFormat.description: Show the times in the interface on a 12-hour or 24-hour clock, in UTC, or with a strftime pattern

timeZone.description: Show the times in the interface in a time zone other than your system's

tui.description: Choose the [fullscreen](/docs/en/fullscreen) or classic terminal renderer

ultracode.description: Have Claude plan a [workflow](/docs/en/workflows#let-claude-decide-with-ultracode) for each substantive task without being asked

useAutoModeDuringPlan.description: Let the [auto mode](/docs/en/permission-modes#eliminate-prompts-with-auto-mode) classifier review shell commands in [plan mode](/docs/en/permission-modes#analyze-before-you-edit-with-plan-mode); set `false` to get prompts instead

verbose.description: Show [full tool output](/docs/en/cli-reference#cli-flags) instead of truncated summaries; `viewMode` takes precedence when both are set

viewMode.description: Start every session in [default, verbose, or focus view](/docs/en/cli-reference#cli-flags)

vimInsertModeRemaps.description: Map a two-key [INSERT-mode sequence](/docs/en/interactive-mode#remap-insert-mode-key-sequences) such as `jj` to Escape

voice.description: Turn on [voice dictation](/docs/en/voice-dictation) and pick hold or tap mode

voiceEnabled.description: Turn on [voice dictation](/docs/en/voice-dictation) with the older single-key form

workflowKeywordTriggerEnabled.description: Let the word `ultracode` in a prompt start a [workflow](/docs/en/workflows); set `false` to type it without starting one

workflowSizeGuideline.description: Set the agent count Claude aims for in [dynamic workflows](/docs/en/workflows)

worktree.description: Configure how Claude Code creates git [worktrees](/docs/en/worktrees)

worktree.baseRef.description: Branch new [worktrees](/docs/en/worktrees) from the remote default branch or your local HEAD

worktree.bgIsolation.description: Let background sessions edit the working copy without a [worktree](/docs/en/worktrees)

worktree.location.description: Choose where [Desktop SSH sessions](/docs/en/desktop#ssh-sessions) create their worktrees on a remote machine

worktree.sparsePaths.description: Check out only the directories you need in each [worktree](/docs/en/worktrees)

worktree.symlinkDirectories.description: Symlink large directories into each [worktree](/docs/en/worktrees) instead of duplicating them

wslInheritsWindowsSettings.description: Have WSL read [managed settings](/docs/en/managed-settings) from the Windows policy chain
